verbatim.text: PURCHASE, N.Y.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Mastercard (NYSE: MA) today completed its acquisition of BVNK, expanding the company’s strategy to support greater choice in how people and businesses exchange value by enabling interoperability across fiat and digital currencies.

segs.t: PURCHASE, N.Y.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Mastercard (NYSE: MA) today completed its acquisition of BVNK, expanding the company’s strategy to support greater choice in how people and businesses exchange value by enabling interoperability across fiat and digital currencies.
